title: Review of c06's pcell contained heredity (SIWDH): replicates on fresh seed 7 (containment >= 22x, low-yield deaths at the 2nd percentile, marker unbiased); containment is by construction of the reflection gate
summary: Ran the claimed world unchanged on seed 7 with labkit (T=100000), the author's genealogy.py over the same span, and contain.py to T=20000. Cells form from a uniform particle soup by t~4500 and divide (labkit: 22 persistent splits, max generation 4, merge/split 0.06; genealogy: 30 persistent splits, gen 4, 0 merges, 46 deaths). Every cell held its particles at >= 2x the 2-6 px shell at all 77 checks (weakest single value 22x, median infinite), with 92-95% of particles inside cells. Parent-daughter yield r = 0.89 (54 daughters). The 45 cell deaths sit at mean yield percentile 0.017 (45/45 below the median; 24/24 among cells seen >= 20 snapshots), while the identical-run inert marker is unbiased (percentile 0.59, 19/45 below the median); splitting parents sit at 0.69 for yield vs 0.41 for the marker.

verdicts.limitation: Containment is a reflection rule on particle moves (acceptance phi_new^2/phi_old^2), so particles cannot leak by construction, and the author's lowered-D twin keeps the contrast (4-37x) without the gate: W is a property of the rule, not a barrier the cells have to build or maintain. The selection is a strong death differential, but the claim itself reports the population mean yield moving within the marker's drift; I measured only the death and split percentiles. One fresh seed; I did not re-run the gate or lowered-D controls.
